cases.title: A returning learner who passed is not re-taught the basics

rubric.reason: read_learner_record ran before snapshot_project, and the opening recalls the earlier lesson in plain words ("Last time, almost four weeks ago, you eased all four Title pairs"). Because the skill is `learned`, it skips the basics and moves on to the record's next step ("let's work on Bar, as planned last time"). It never mentions the file or its field names.

The opening proposes one layer (Bar), with Glow offered only as an alternative, so two layers at most. It names 4 pairs with times (Bar's 3 plus Subtitle Opacity), under the limit of 5, and gives the rest as counts ("11 pairs ... across 6 layers").

Every name and time matches tool output. 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased, and the 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take. Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s matches linear_end "end" with to_time 1.3. Bar X Position 0–0.6 s and 0.6–1.2 s and Trim Paths End 0.2–1.2 s (Contents › Rectangle › Contents › Trim Paths 1) match the snapshot. Logo's single-key Scale and expression-driven Rotation match `skipped`, and Old Take, Icon and Glow Blurriness all appear in the snapshot.

read_learner_record is called before snapshot_project, and the opening recaps the earlier lesson in plain words ("you eased Title in Mentor Practice and finished all four of its pairs"). It skips the basics for a learned skill and moves on to the record's next suggestion, Bar's X Position and Trim Paths End, without naming the file or its fields.

The opening proposes one layer ("I suggest Bar as the focus") and names only 4 specific pairs: Bar's three plus Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s. Everything else is given as counts ("11 pairs that still need easing, across 6 layers").

Every name and time matches the snapshot. "11 pairs across 6 layers" is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take. Subtitle Opacity 0.3–1.3 s with a hard stop at 1.3 s matches linear_end "end". Bar X Position 0–0.6/0.6–1.2 s and Trim Paths End 0.2–1.2 s under Contents › Rectangle, plus Old Take, Icon and Logo Rotation/Scale, all appear in findings, hidden_layers, precomp_layers or skipped.

read_learner_record runs before snapshot_project, and the opening recalls the earlier Title lesson in plain words ("you got the basics down... Title's Position from 1.5 to 3 s, which you missed at first"). For a learner marked learned, it moves on to the record's next step, Bar ("we'll focus on finding the keys rather than on what easing is"), and never mentions the file or its field names.

The opening proposes Bar but ends by asking the learner to choose among three layers ("Want to go with Bar, or would you rather do a quick review on another layer, like CTRL or Glow?"), which exceeds the two-layer limit.

Every name and time matches the tool output: Bar X Position 0–0.6/0.6–1.2 s, Trim Paths End 0.2–1.2 s under Contents › Rectangle › Contents, Subtitle Opacity partly_eased 0.3–1.3 s with linear_end at the end, Old Take hidden, Icon precomp, and 11 pairs across 6 layers (10 linear + 1 partly_eased); Title Position 1.5–3 s comes from the learner record result.
